features: Linux Preview sequence plays source cuts/audio directly without full MP4 export, project save or version
Shared cards/photo/video inserts/placements/zoom composed during playback
Immutable preview snapshot; newer edits preserved
Bounded cancellable IPC with partial replies retained and commands sent once
Nonblocking clean-player-exit handoff; genuine live failures still reported
Explicit Export MP4 retains progress/local-version behavior

startup.method: Generated160x90 inputs,1080 project, isolated Xvfb and test-only null audio. Descriptive startup observations for two workloads, not an isolated causal comparison; mute settings differ. Existing host workload not controlled. Decoder/player initialization included, test-data construction excluded. No competing build/encoding jobs.

limits: Linux direct preview only; other platforms retain rendered compatibility preview.
Source validation/player initialization and finishing an active take still take time.
Large source lists over mpv0.37 EDL1MB limit explicitly reject; no hidden export fallback.
Direct source time and Export30fps rounding may differ by less than a frame at clip boundaries.
Dynamic visual composition still performs CPU work.
No physical camera/microphone/speaker test or audible/lip-sync claim; missing OBSBOT and distorted recordings remain separate.
Interview editor and Record studio remain separate; app unification not included.
